channel.title: SuperRobots — China Robotics News
channel.description: English summaries of Chinese robotics news and primary sources.

item.title: Humanoid robots take the stage in Guangzhou
item.description: A National Day show puts coordinated humanoid performances and public interaction in the spotlight at the Guangdong Science Center. Original source: China Youth Daily / Sina (https://finance.sina.com.cn/jjxw/2026-10-02/doc-initusmm4796722.shtml).

item.title: AgiBot’s A3 gets a native NetEase Cloud Music integration
item.description: Voice-controlled music is scheduled to reach the full-size humanoid on October 15. Music-generated movement remains a development goal. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/236.html).

item.title: More than 300 robots join the everyday life of a theme park
item.description: AgiBot and Chimelong put robots to work across performances, visitor guidance, education, retail, and hospitality in Hengqin. Original source: AgiBot (https://www.agibot.com.cn/article/315/detail/231.html).

item.title: Unitree releases its humanoid base model and fine-tuning code
item.description: The Chinese project README records a September 28 release of UnifoLM-WLA-1.0-Base and tools for adapting the model. Original source: Unitree · Chinese project README (https://github.com/unitreerobotics/unifolm-wla/blob/main/README_zh.md).

item.title: A wheeled tennis robot meets Wang Qiang on court
item.description: LimX Dynamics and Enhance pair a TRON 2 mobile platform with a tennis-training system at the Billie Jean King Cup finals. Original source: LimX Dynamics (https://www.limxdynamics.com/zh/news/BK000125).

item.title: Unitree’s G1+ adds stronger joints and richer sensing
item.description: The upgraded humanoid brings a two-axis neck, stereo and wide-angle vision, touch sensing, and external power support. Original source: Shangguan News / Sina (https://finance.sina.com.cn/jjxw/2026-09-22/doc-inistewv6764719.shtml).

item.title: D-Robotics raises $400 million for robot chips and development tools
item.description: The Series C round backs Sunrise chips and a software platform spanning data collection, training, simulation, and deployment. Original source: Shenzhen News (https://www.sznews.com/news/content/2026-09/17/content_32173727.htm).
